name: Project
why: A task from the project chat to a merged pull request, each step held to one metric
ideal: A cloud thread reads its guards, delegates side work to cheap read-only agents, opens its pull request early and merges within a day.

sources.title: Claude Code Docs: Let Claude coordinate ongoing work with Projects
Claude Code Docs: How Claude remembers your project
Claude Code Docs: Create custom subagents

steps.name: Brief
steps.rule: Each guard is said in a file a cloud thread reads, never only in settings.json.

steps.name: Load
steps.rule: Each instruction file stays under 200 lines, so a thread keeps its context for the work.

steps.name: Delegate
steps.rule: A read-only subagent lists only reading tools, so side work cannot change the repo.

steps.name: Route
steps.rule: Each subagent names its model, so side work runs on a small one.

steps.name: Ship
steps.rule: A thread opens its draft pull request within 10 minutes of its first commit.

steps.name: Merge
steps.rule: A green pull request merges within a day, then the thread stops watching it.
